name: HuiZhou Intelligence Technology Group Co., Ltd
summary: HuiZhou Intelligence Technology Group Co., Ltd engages in the high-end equipment manufacturing business in China and internationally.offers CNC heavy-duty vertical lathes, CNC heavy-duty horizontal lathes, five-axis machining centers, vertical machining centers, horizontal machining centers, heavy-duty deep hole drilling and boring machines, roll lathes, vertical grinding machines, and vertical gear milling machines. The company serves transportation, energy, metallurgy, mining, machinery, shipbuilding, and automotive industries. It exports its products.
